fact: The Ministry of the Interior and Security officially presented the Annuaire statistique d'état civil 2024 and its analysis report on 30 June 2025, covering births, adoptions, marriages, divorces and deaths registered in 2024.
The Annuaire statistique d'état civil 2024, compiled from civil registration records and covering 2024, was presented on 30 June 2025 by the Ministry of the Interior and Security.

The Interior Ministry's DESPSE, with ANSTAT and UNICEF, presented the 2025 civil-status statistical yearbook on 31 July 2026, built from collected birth, adoption, marriage, divorce and death records.
The 2025 yearbook covers births, adoptions, marriages, divorces and deaths registered in civil status.
